import json,pathlib,importlib.util,re
r=pathlib.Path.cwd(); folder=r/'logs/pbs/gen_train_concurrency_s15_01-20261109T061808Z-d55c575e'
p=json.loads((folder/'payload.json').read_text()); receipt=json.loads((folder/'submission.json').read_text())
assert receipt['returncode']==0
assert re.findall(r'\b\d+\.hopper-m-\d+\b',receipt['stdout'])==['707807.hopper-m-02']
assert p['requested_gpu_count']==1 and p['requested_wall_seconds']==7870 and p['queue']=='autox' and p['requested_host'] is None and p['budget_group']=='G01'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase',r/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py'); module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
state=module.budget_state(r)
reserve=p['requested_gpu_count']*p['requested_wall_seconds']/3600*p['requested_queue_charge_rate']
s=r/'STATUS.md'
note=f'''
### G01 first benchmark submitted

PBS707807.hopper-m-02 is the first G01 concurrency benchmark: oneGPU/12CPU, premium/autox, no host pin, walltime02:11:10. Its requested ceiling reserves {reserve} chargedGPUh; actual runtime will replace this only after final PBS accounting. It repeats the same six training scenes under2/4/6 concurrency; each GPU will first pass the original render gate. No additional bulk jobs are submitted before actual throughput/stability results.

Current accounted-or-reserved subbudgets are {json.dumps(state['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],sort_keys=True)}; shared phase {state['accounted_or_reserved_total']}/60. The earlier S15 accounting measurements remain preserved, but the budget's strict producer check only recognizes its canonical file-path invocation; t01v2_flip_s15_accounting_canonical now supplies that original-entry final record without changing any accounting tool.

Receipt: logs/pbs/gen_train_concurrency_s15_01-20261109T061808Z-d55c575e. Code and CPU evidence were pushed before submission (19d8c4a). Queue wait remains pending until PBS records a start/final history.
'''
assert '### G01 first benchmark submitted' not in s.read_text()
s.write_text(s.read_text()+note)
print('G01_SUBMISSION: '+json.dumps({'job_id':'707807.hopper-m-02','reserved_charged_gpu_hours':reserve,'budget':state},sort_keys=True))
